end.parentNote: Asha practised making 10 with number pairs and finger counting. Gauri explained that 6 and 4 and 7 and 3 make 10, and used fingers to show 7 and 3. They initially thought only 5 and 5 could make 10; this was corrected during the lesson, though the different pairs still felt confusing. At home, practise with objects by asking, “How many more make 10?” and use a few different pairs.
